question: Which Indian environmental activist was in the news for leading a youth movement in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Licypriya Kangujam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Licypriya Kangujam**, often referred to as the "Indian Greta Thunberg," is a prominent **Indian environmental activist** who gained global attention for her efforts to combat climate change.
 
• Born on **2 October 2011** in **Manipur, India**, Licypriya became active in environmental advocacy at the young age of 7. She is one of the youngest climate activists in the world.
 
• In 2025, she led a significant **youth movement** advocating for stronger climate actions and the implementation of policies to safeguard the environment for future generations.
 
• Her activism includes urging the Government of India to pass a **climate law** to mitigate the effects of climate change and protect biodiversity.
 
• She is the founder of the **Child Movement**, an organization that empowers children to raise their voices against climate inaction and environmental degradation.
 
• Licypriya has addressed several international forums, including the **United Nations Climate Conferences**, and has received numerous accolades for her contributions to environmental preservation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Licypriya Kangujam:**

 
 
• Licypriya is widely recognized for her campaign to make environmental education a mandatory subject in schools in India.
 
• At the age of 9, she was awarded the prestigious **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Children Award** for her remarkable contributions to environmental advocacy.
 
• She introduced the concept of the **SUKIFU (Survival Kit for the Future)**, an innovative portable device to address air pollution, which gained attention globally.
 
 
 
• **Notable Contributions of Other Options:**
 
 
• **Medha Patkar:** An Indian social activist known for her work in the **Narmada Bachao Andolan**, focusing on environmental and human rights issues.
 
• **Disha Ravi:** A young Indian climate activist and a member of the **Fridays for Future** movement. She gained attention in 2021 for her involvement in environmental campaigns.
 
• **Ridhima Pandey:** An Indian environmental activist who filed a petition with the United Nations in 2017, urging action against climate change. At the age of 9, she was one of the youngest petitioners to challenge global leaders on their inaction.
 
 
 
• **Global Youth Movements:**
 
 
• Youth-led climate movements have gained momentum worldwide, with activists like **Greta Thunberg** inspiring millions to demand urgent climate action.
 
• These movements emphasize the need for **sustainability, renewable energy adoption**, and policies to reduce carbon emissions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Licypriya's Advocacy:**

 
 
• She emphasizes the role of **youth participation** in decision-making processes related to climate policies.
 
• Her campaigns focus on reducing **plastic waste**, mitigating air pollution, and promoting afforestation.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Youth Movements:**
 
 
• Youth movements like Licypriya's have played a crucial role in holding governments accountable for their commitments under agreements like the **Paris Climate Accord**.
 
• They also inspire citizens worldwide to adopt eco-friendly habits and support sustainable development initiatives.
